notes:
YLLW 0.5.9
- Fixed: pages could run off the right edge of every phone. A width set in the Style panel (on the demo's intro text, heading or buttons, for example) carried over to phone panes and pushed the page wider than the screen. Widths you set, in any unit, now stay inside their parent, including edits you already have.
- The demo site's columns can no longer be stretched by one wide item, so it wraps and fits from 320px phones up.
- The demo no longer logs "ready at 0px" while a pane is still opening.
- The iPhone SE no longer shows a stray home-bar line.
